In musical chairs, while his rivals hit the floor, Messi gets a personal referee to slide a chair right under him. ​The special treatment doesn't stop there. During "Pin the World Cup on Argentina," Infantino personally guides his hand for a bullseye. In 'Pass the Parcel', the prize is obviously another Golden Ball! The absolute peak? When it's time to blow out the World Cup candle, VAR steps in to rule Kylian Mbappé's breath 'offside'! ​As the party wraps up, Ronaldo and Mbappé are sent packing in tears with "EMPTY" party bags, while Messi flexes his "GOODIY" bag overflowing with golden trophies. With Infantino's "Little King" falling asleep on a giant, smashed World Cup cake, the infamous favoritism debate is settled once again. 😂 ​Do you think Infantino's love for his favorite number 10 is going a bit too far?
